import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd
from shapely.geometry import Point

# Chicago's green roofs, each a point at its latitude and longitude
green_roofs_df = pd.read_csv(curio_data_path("data.cityofchicago.green-roofs"))
geometry = [Point(xy) for xy in zip(green_roofs_df['LONGITUDE'], green_roofs_df['LATITUDE'])]
green_roofs_df = gpd.GeoDataFrame(green_roofs_df, geometry=geometry, crs=4326)

# Keep the roofs inside the city boundary
chicago = gpd.read_file(curio_data_path("data.utk.chicago-boundary"))
joined = gpd.sjoin(green_roofs_df, chicago, predicate='within')
return joined
nodes.goal: Load Chicago's green roofs inside the city boundary, each with its zip code and vegetated square feet.
nodes.title: Load green roofs
